$comment: Validates _source/grs-json-changes.json, which is the single source of truth of the GRS JSON change ledger (Chapter 6.2 of 05-07-design.md). It is not generated from anything and nothing is generated from it: check 76 validates the manuscript against it, and docs/spec/_source/erd_json_to_schema.py prints the manuscript's changes into the published schema as x-grsChanges.
It is where the fields of one ledger element are said (Chapter 6.2 points here): version, kind, entity, column, and per kind default (added), to (renamed) or rule (converted).

changes.description: Oldest first; an element is appended, never rewritten. Empty while S-541 of table T-206 is null.

version.description: The format version that landed the change (FR-073: RFC 3339 UTC, seconds, no fraction).

kind.description: How the latest GRS reads an older document: added -> fill default; removed -> drop silently (as table T-297); renamed -> move to `to`; converted -> read by the named `rule`; refused -> refuse the whole document (RS-25).

entity.description: The entity of the changed column (an entity name of table T-058); a presentation key names documentSettings.

column.description: The changed column, under its name before that version.

default.description: added only: the value an older document is read with.

rule.description: converted only: the name of the rule the reading path applies.
